summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper sit right on top of your thinking and how you talk and decide. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The challenge is learning when to slow the conversation down. Both of you may be quick to respond, quick to react, or quick to move to the next point before fully taking in what was said. At times, this can create unnecessary tension or make a simple difference of opinion feel bigger than it is.
advice: This aspect works better when both people track how and when things are said.
